exact_result: From the supplied actual-model strong+finite-entropy recovery theorem: quantitative actual maximal-ray convergence, L1 Legendre raw mass-profile convergence, all-dimensional interior d_S singularity and all mixed level-mass convergence, discrepancy uniform integrability, and a joint model-index/large-time entropy limit from a fixed smooth Kähler start. An explicit relatively ample P1 model calibrates energy and positive discrepancy and demonstrates fixed-endpoint failure for a bad actual model sequence. Energy-defect obstruction rules out only a specified maximal-model/usual-datum mechanism. The entire unchanged original residual P19.2 is not solved.
concrete_gaps: No complete simultaneous approximation construction for every finer prescribed P-envelope/singularity signature of the original residual target, and no genuine nonexistence counterexample to that full existence target.
Interior d_S convergence is a precise partial topology; exact indexwise P-equivalence and exact pole preservation are not proved.
Endpoint and zero-mass prescribed levels are not generally recovered; an explicit translated model sequence fails at a fixed positive-mass endpoint, while a constant sequence succeeds.
Relative level-envelope and joint entropy assertions for genuine singular finite-energy initial potentials remain unproved; only actual fixed-time d1 ray convergence is established there.

Joint entropy theorem concerns H(r_j(t))/t with j,t jointly tending to infinity on a fixed manifold from a fixed smooth Kähler start. It is not fixed-time entropy continuity, a full hybrid entropy limit, or a degenerating-family compactness theorem.
Actual model recovery relies on the exact supplied mathematical theorem R, not an independently reconstructed entire special-Fujita proof in this draft.
